title: Settings

model_fit.fits: This model fits on your machine (needs about {gb} GB).
model_fit.tight: ⚠️ '{model}' is heavy for your machine: it needs about {required} GB and you have {available} GB free. It may die mid-answer. Lighter options: {suggestions}
model_fit.too_big: ⚠️ '{model}' does not fit on your machine: it needs about {required} GB but only {available} GB is free. The model will crash while generating. Suggested: {suggestions}
model_fit.unknown: This model's size cannot be determined from its name.
model_fit.no_room: ⚠️ This machine does not have enough memory to run a local model (about {required} GB needed). Use a cloud provider such as OpenRouter instead.

doctor.running: Running step-by-step checks… this can take a few minutes.
doctor.cpu_offload: Warning: the model does not fit entirely in GPU memory and part of it runs on the CPU. That is slow and makes the runner fragile.
doctor.verdict_offline: Ollama is not reachable. Run 'ollama serve' in a separate window.
doctor.verdict_no_models: No model is installed. Try 'ollama pull llama3.2:3b'.
doctor.verdict_healthy: Every step passed; Ollama handles the app's full load.
doctor.verdict_broken_service: Even the lightest request failed. The problem is Ollama itself or the GPU driver, not this app.
doctor.verdict_load_limit: A light request succeeded but a heavier one failed: the model cannot sustain the real load. This is common on low-VRAM cards.
doctor.advice_cpu: Running fully on the CPU is usually more stable: in PowerShell set $env:OLLAMA_VULKAN="false" then ollama serve.
doctor.advice_small: Or use a smaller model: ollama pull llama3.2:3b
